description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in the Orleans hosting project, providing functionality to configure services, options, configuration bindings, and logging within the silo builder pattern.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure services, options, configuration, and logging.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds services to the IServiceCollection within the ISiloBuilder, allowing multiple calls to augment the service collection.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a specific options type TOptions by applying a provided configuration action.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Binds a configuration instance to the specified options type TOptions.

methods.name: ConfigureLogging
methods.description: Adds logging configuration to the IServiceCollection within the ISiloBuilder.
